pool.text: The Portuguese governor moved the administration east to establish Dili as the new capital.
The settlement of Dili was officially declared to be a city.
A new cathedral opened in Dili following the demolition of the main church.
Civil war broke out between political parties leading to an Indonesian invasion.
Indonesia formally annexed the territory of East Timor as its province.
Pope John Paul II visited Dili and independent activists interrupted the event.
Forces from Indonesia were filmed shooting at a funeral procession in Dili.
Dili established a sister city twinning arrangement with Lisbon, Portugal.
Dili became the capital city of an independent Timor-Leste.
Dili established a sister city twinning arrangement with Canberra, Australia.
Internal military disputes resulted in violent street clashes occurring in Dili.
EuroAtlantic Airways operated a direct flight from Lisbon using a Boeing 757.
The government launched the City of Peace campaign to lower civic tensions.
The Dili City of Peace marathon was held for the first time.
The first cinema opened inside a newly built shopping centre named Timor Plaza.
Dili established a sister city twinning arrangement with Manila, Philippines.
Dili port served a total of 198,080 passengers and 172 tons of cargo.
The city hosted the inaugural Dili International Film Festival event.
Construction work officially began on the port project on August 30.
Port construction reached 42% completion amidst pandemic delays involving Chinese workers.
